title: Champignon Witch Manga to Resume After 10 Months
content: Hakusensha 's Manga Park platform scheduled a new chapter of Tachibana Higuchi 's Champignon Witch ( Champignon no Majo ) manga in early access for premium users on November 27. This will mark the first new chapter for the series since January.
author: ANN

title: Sakamoto Days Manga Ends
content: This year's 52nd issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump published the final chapter of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga on Monday. Shueisha will publish the manga's 30th compiled book volume on January 4, 2027, followed by the 31st and final volume on April 30.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Needs to Retcon One of Its Weirdest Android 18 Choices
content: The story of Dragon Ball is known for being goofy and off-beat beyond the battlefield. For all its serious moments, the story features characters with food names, an afterlife where bad guys are tortured by fairies and Mr. Satan changing to Hercule in the English dub and more amongst other numerous funny bits .
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Most Powerful One Piece Characters Luffy’s Gear 5 Can’t Defeat
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! Ever since the One Piece manga began serialization in 1997, Luffy has steadily grown more powerful. title: Live-Action The Remarried Empress Series Drives Surge in Original Webtoon, Web Novel Readership
content: Naver WEBTOON reported on November 19 that readership of the original The Remarried Empress webtoon and web novel surged following the premiere of its Disney+ live-action series.
author: ANN

title: I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game Web Novel, Webtoon Gets Mobile Game Adaptation
content: WEBZEN, a Korean game developer and publisher, has announced it is developing a mobile strategy RPG based on the web novel and webtoon I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game . Titled I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game: Last Stage , the game is scheduled for release in 2027.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Is About to Unravel a Mystery That Has Kept Fans Guessing for 3 Years
content: One Piece ‘s latest chapter has begun unraveling a mystery that the series introduced over three years ago, in May 2023, and it could change much of what fans know about the series.
author: ComicBook

title: Martial Arts Manhwa Yeolhyeol Gangho to End Next Year After 33 Years
content: The long-running Korean martial arts manhwa Yeolhyeol Gangho , also known as The Ruler of the Land in English, is scheduled to conclude in February 2027 with its 97th collected volume, ending a serialization that began more than 30 years ago.
author: ANN
